notes: The clause's negation is carried by the written בִלְתִּי, so the privative frame's complementizer alone goes to the preposition under rule 48's present-morpheme sentence, and the infinitive keeps its supplied subject and modal.
Both articles of הָאֲנָשִׁים הָהֵמָּה are unrepresented, the single written determiner *those* going to the demonstrative pronoun.
*kept back* is one lexical verb plus its phrasal particle, so the head stays on the verb under rule 44.
